newsitem.title: USA: NGC/Equitable Resources affiliate files Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: NGC/Equitable Resources affiliate files Chapter 11.

text.p: A partnership partly owned by units of NGC Corp and Equitable Resources Inc filed for Chapter 11 protection, according to papers filed Tuesday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.

The Avoca Natural Gas Storage partnership is 46.8 percent owned by JMC Avoca Inc, a unit of J. Makowski Co Inc; 28.1 percent owned by NGC subsidiary NGC Storage Inc; and 25.0 percent owned by Equitable subsidiary ET Avoca Co.

Equitable director of investor relations Robert Atkinson told Reuters "The partnership, created to construct and operate an imbedded salt storage project for natural gas in Avoca, N.Y., was deemed non-economic."
